query: I'm evaluating a 52-year-old man. Among male inpatients aged 47–57 with AKI, what is the mean 72-hour laboratory instability score? Compare critical-event frequency, average length of stay, and in-hospital mortality versus age-matched male controls.
final_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.labevent_id) FROM labevents e WHERE e.subject_id = m.subject_id AND e.charttime > m.admittime + interval '72 hours' AND e.value != e.valueuom) AS instability_score, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.microevent_id) FROM microbiologyevents e WHERE e.subject_id = m.subject_id AND e.chartdate > m.admittime + interval '72 hours' AND e.test_itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_labitems WHERE category = 'Sensitivity')) AS critical_events, m.total_stays, m.avg_length_of_stay, m.mortality_rate, c.total_stays, c.avg_length_of_stay, c.mortality_rate FROM male_patients m JOIN male_controls c ON m.anchor_age = c.anchor_age AND m.anchor_year = c.anchor_year AND m.anchor_year_group = c.anchor_year_group;
